Team — forwarding procurement's ask. Summary: GreenCrest (prospect) needs quarterly invoices + Net-90 on the pilot. Deal details: pilot 3 months, estimated spend $62.5k per quarter, potential ARR $250k if converted. They will provide an approved PO if we accept terms.

Ask: need Deal Desk / Finance / Exec decision on whether we can accept quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for a pilot (and if any guardrails required). Proposed mitigations I've considered:
- Require signed PO before start
- Credit cap (e.g., $200k) and milestone acceptance for invoicing
- Short trial duration (3 months) with right to revert to monthly billing on renewal

Timelines: procurement expects a yes/no by EOD Thu so they can issue PO. Attaching my suggested invoice cadence sheet for reference (invoice_proposal_Q4.xlsx).

Olga

Olga / team —

Thanks for the context. Key finance concerns: Net-90 materially increases our DSO and credit exposure. Before I can approve, we need:
1) A signed PO in advance of start (Emily indicated procurement will provide one)
2) Credit limit set and tracked (proposing a $200k cap during pilot)
3) Milestone acceptance clauses tied to invoicing or an escrow/retainer for first quarter if we can't secure a PO that guarantees payment dates

If Deal Desk / Sales Ops prefer to avoid a retainer, we could accept Net-90 for the pilot conditionally with the $200k cap and requirement that PO references the grant funding line and expected remit date. Finance will escalate if historical payment issues appear.

I'll draft a one-paragraph approval memo for Exec review once Deal Desk confirms guardrails.

-Rishi

Jonas —

Quick background: GreenCrest is a high-probability mid-market opportunity introduced by OL team. Pilot value ~ $62.5k for the quarter, converting to $250k ARR opportunity. Procurement requires quarterly invoices and Net-90 for this grant-funded pilot. They will provide an approved PO if we agree.

Finance (Rishi) will support a conditional approval if we:
- Accept quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for the pilot only
- Set a $200k credit cap during the pilot
- Require an approved PO that references the grant funding line before kickoff

Recommendation: Approve conditional terms to avoid losing the deal. Risks: DSO increase and carry of receivable; mitigated by PO + credit cap. If approved, ask Legal to ensure PO references and billing schedule are captured and Finance to set the credit limit.

Decision needed by EOD Thu to keep procurement timeline.
